approval.title: Approval path, from water main bid to permits
approval.lede: The DA must be executed and the water main financial security provided, and the CSM and Stormwater Maintenance Agreement recorded, before the Village issues any permits for the project (S&O condition 1). The Village sizes the security at 120% of the public improvements, inspections and construction-related services, from the signed contract (DA conditions 6 and 7). The Village schedules the preconstruction meeting once all S&O condition 5 submittals are in. The building permit must be issued within 6 months of the 8/17/26 approval. Bid, contract, closing and construction dates are not set.
